name: Safety paperwork on paper
summary: Turns the safety paperwork a construction business does by hand (pre-starts, SWMS, sign-off, incident and close-out records) into SiteBook records, and reminds the crew when reviews and actions fall due. Crons read and draft; every reminder email waits for a person to approve it.

paper-safety.evidence: 13 discovery calls describe this way of doing safety paperwork

covered_by.pre-start: draft (pre-start checklist from a template, with the SWMS attached)
covered_by.swms-prepare: draft (SWMS attached to the checklist, review action raised when due)
covered_by.file-store: not yet (Dropbox has no platform in the kit)

crons.name: pre-start
crons.summary: Weekday mornings, before the crew starts: a pre-start checklist for each job that does not have one yet, with the standard SWMS attached.

crons.name: swms-review
crons.summary: Weekly: raise a review action for each SWMS whose last review is older than the review window.

crons.name: reminders
crons.summary: Daily: queue a reminder email for each open action that falls due soon, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a checklist created from a template, a SWMS attached to it, an internal review action. The reminder email to an action's recipient is a live operation and waits for a person.

sitebook.covers: pre-start checklist, SWMS attachment, SWMS review action, action reminder email

gaps: Procore: its help pages map a site inspection, incident, action plan and forms, but the kit has no Procore platform and no ops file, so nothing is mapped. Pre-start, SWMS and toolbox talks are not in its crawled pages at all.
Sitemate: its help pages map inspections, inductions and actions, but the kit has no Sitemate platform and no ops file, so nothing is mapped.
SiteBook incident and sign-off records: the incident create endpoint and the sign-off body fields are not in the docs crawl, so incident-report and sign-off stay on paper.
SiteBook regulator and electrical portal lodgements: no endpoint in the docs crawl. The licensed person keys these in by hand.

SiteBook field names for list responses (jobs, actions, SWMS) are not confirmed in the docs crawl, which shows request bodies and single-record examples only. The adapter reads them defensively and skips any record without an id.

SiteBook CheckListId, ActionId and the conditional AssetId on checklist create: the docs say AssetId is required when no AssetGroupId is given, and ActionId is client-supplied. The pre-start cron does not run until settings set asset_id or asset_group_id, and sends whichever is set. Confirm the requirement and the field names on a sandbox account before live use.

Pre-start: a job whose checklist create fails after the call is held in the store as pending, so the cron never makes a second checklist for it. A person checks SiteBook for that job, then removes its prestart record from the store before it is retried. The cron never removes it.
Dropbox document folders, ASA Safety and AWSA Safety: no platform in the kit, so the file store and the safety-system step stay with the business.
Judgment steps stay with the agent skill in SKILL.md: writing the SWMS for a new task, close-out photo selection, and the handover pack.
Every adapter is docs-only until a SiteBook sandbox or trial account proves the calls.

evidence.calls: 13 of 31 read safety discovery calls describe how they do it; SWMS preparation is 90 percent manual in those calls
evidence.platforms: SiteBook's developer docs for pre-start, SWMS, action and reminder endpoints; Procore and Sitemate help pages were checked and have no mapped operations in the kit
